svg.title: From your fork to a pull request that merges cleanly
svg.desc: How to contribute to alexander-kastil/claude-harness from the fork aeshilion/claude-harness. Three columns, left to right: the upstream repo on GitHub, the fork on GitHub (origin), and the local clone on your machine. Time runs top to bottom, and each of the steps 1 to 9 is a row, numbered on the left. The animation plays the steps in order and shows the commits moving between the columns. Step 6, merging upstream master into the feature branch right before the pull request, is the step that avoids conflicts. Step 8 loops back to it while the pull request is open. The column on the right names the Claude Code command on the row of its step: /git-contribute-setup for step 2, /git-contribute-start for 3 and 4, /git-sideload for 5, /git-contribute-sync for 6 and 8, /git-contribute-pr for 7 and /git-contribute-finish for 9. Below the steps, /git-contribute-cleanup deletes a feature branch you no longer need.
svg.text: From your fork to a pull request that merges cleanly
